Name: Wren's Expanded Cellar
Author: cowboylikenyx
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/I71ihcX.png[/img]

Wren's Expanded Cellar is the second mod project that I've created for [url=http://stardewvalley.net]Stardew Valley 1.5[/url]. This will give you an extended version of the vanilla cellar. This mod also give you a Jukebox, a computer that lets you see your Farmer File & also a cave that will replenish your energy.

As of now, this mod may be compatible with other mods that doesn't mess with the cellar.

[b][size=4]Features:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]A fully functional jukebox
[*]A computer that lets you see your Farmer File
[*]A cave that contains pool (fully functional - replenishes your energy) [i]You can use the underground door next to the ladder to access the cave[/i]
[/list]
[size=4][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/2ZxwxX5.png[/img]
